BRACKLEY RESERVOIR · ROUTINE SAMPLING · JUNE 2032
Laboratory copy. Not for release.

sample   date     lead (µg/l)   limit   result

BR-062   10 Jun   31            10      FAIL
BR-063   17 Jun   44            10      FAIL
BR-064   24 Jun   47            10      FAIL

Lab note: three fails in a row. Source is the old feeder main at Harlow Lane. Supply should be stopped and households told today.

Reply from operations, 25 Jun: supply stays on. Retest in the autumn. Do not write to households. Do not send this to the regulator until legal has seen it.

Nothing was sent to the regulator.
